model: DeepSeek-v4 same private Native export/import build on P and D and colocated arms

fixture.quality: Parse complete final object using existing content_json policy, exact fixture tool nonce/integer results, natural EOS separately from length. This fixed historical request does not establish broad benchmark quality.

sampling: Same pinned Native topk1/topp1/temp1 actual greedy source path; HTTP defaults do not determine Native sampling
optimization_flags: Same fixed flags in all arms; no epilogue/fullpre optin changes between co and PD; exact newDSO and dependency/source hashes required before execution

planned_role_request_lifecycles.Native_forward_calls: Depends on actual natural EOS and complete prompt chunks; not21 or14. Each PD prompt must be consumed once on P and zero times on D.

handoff.first_token: P emits the token selected after the final prefill chunk; cache past is8489. Carry that exact next-token ID to D; D first forward input is the carried token at position8489, not prompt replay. If P emits EOS, preserve it as early terminal with no fabricated D continuation.
handoff.first_token_clock: Report arrival of actual P first token even when state transfer is still in progress; never delay this timestamp to hide transfer gap.
handoff.complete_state: Actual Native semantic inventory required: all KV/compressed/index/rolling state and lengths/validity/row/epoch metadata. No export/import qualification yet.
handoff.ownership: One distinct nonce/epoch per external request. P snapshot frozen until D confirms group-wide import; no cross-request prefix reuse. D publish after complete all8shard verification/fence; failed or unknown handoff is poisoned, no retry/reload.
handoff.overlap: Capacity PD may prefill request2 while D decodes request1 only after snapshot/ownership handoff is complete. Preserve actual copy/communication interference and blocked-stage/queue times.
handoff.transport: First candidate explicit hoststaged TCP/IPoIB. DeviceDirect/RDMA unsupported as a claim until actual current-consumer registration/copies prove the path.

clock_and_cost.client: Single client/controller monotonic clock for admission, first-visible/last-visible tokens, HTTP completion and offered arrivals. Actual incremental stream required for client metrics; buffered wires only support completion.
clock_and_cost.backend: Each source clock domain labeled. Never subtract P monotonic from D monotonic. Per-source local phase timers and sender-local finalACK envelope.
clock_and_cost.tokens: Exclude EOS/control IDs from useful-token rate; per-user decode=(visible_n-1)/(last_visible-first_visible), include P-to-D ITL gap. Include failed/rejected/unfinished requests in planned denominators.
clock_and_cost.capacity: Same16cards: two co replicas vs P8+D8. Group makespan ends at all planned requests terminal, not first completion. Report useful tokens/group wall/16 and all queue delays.
clock_and_cost.latency: Single co request uses one8card replica vs PD16cards. State this resource difference. Whole experiment retains both replicas resident and reports full16card seconds including idleD, coldload, warmup, copies and teardown.
clock_and_cost.qualified_scope: One fixed complete historical8Ktool request, three warmups (coP,coD,PD), one latencyABBA and one two-request cohortABBA. Not online arrival stability, broad quality, or a production SLO.

remaining_before_GPU: Exact complete Native state export/import implementation, CPU/isolated link and actual ownership/shape closure
Source/ABI/checkpoint/current binding pins, timed driver/controller, original-deadline/no-retry and independent cleanup closure
Ordinary push of exact final source/CPU receipts/resources/budget before fresh idle and once-only model batch
stop: Any unexpected Native/transport/identity/state/numeric/lifecycle failure preserves partial work and stops remaining requests, no replay or automatic reload. Wrong task/cap remains reported; no false qualification. If true PD unavailable, report the precise gap instead of replacing it with recomputation.
warmup_revision_before_any_GPU: Both P/D execute an actual colocated warmup before measured comparisons. This avoids D firstprefillkernel cold cost contaminating capacity baseline; no additional Model loads or formal samples.
